page: Amazon Web Services r8id.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by a dedicated 3.9 GHz Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor using the x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance integrates 64 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-dense workloads. It also includes 474 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage alongside a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Accelerator hardware is not included, leaving GPU count at zero.

Benchmark results show balanced compute output and notable single-threaded speed. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 2177.0, placing it in the top 25 percent, while multi-core compute in stress-ng reached 8648.61, within the middle 50 percent range. Memory subsystems exhibit consistent throughput, delivering 68.58 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 49.03 GB/sec in write operations. Single-threaded data handling excels, highlighted by gzip compression speeds of 34.56 GB/sec and top-decile Geekbench text processing scores of 2983.0. In-memory data store performance measured 15.3 million operations per second during Redis SET testing.

Hardware tradeoffs focus heavily on local disk latency and memory capacity over raw parallel compute throughput or extended networking headroom. While 4 Gbps baseline networking is modest, the inclusion of direct-attached NVMe storage removes external EBS latency for caching and temporary scratch files. The hardware configuration provides strong cost efficiency for deployments needing high RAM-per-core allocations and fast local storage without the overhead of enterprise-scale vCPU footprints. This profile aligns directly with in-memory caching layers, relational database instances, text analysis engines, ETL preprocessing, and intermediate build nodes.
description: Amazon Web Services r8id.2xlarge is a memory-optimized Nitro hypervisor instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor clocked at 3.9 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 64 GB of DDR5 system memory running at 7 GHz, and 474 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating without discrete GPU hardware, the instance includes 4 Gbps baseline network throughput. Performance testing reflects strong single-core capabilities, registering a 2177.0 Geekbench single-core score and 34.56 GB/sec gzip compression throughput. Redis SET benchmarks yielded 15.3 million operations per second, complemented by 68.58 GB/sec read bandwidth in large memory blocks. Offering an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio alongside integrated NVMe disk storage, the r8id.2xlarge delivers efficient density for in-memory databases, Redis caches, data pipeline stages, and transactional backend systems.
